_about: Garden visitor derivation (List 22 #212). A visitor is computed at read from the Garden-complex tables + adjacent stocked tables + #19 phase; it is never stored, never kept, and changes no state anywhere — including #14's dex states (a visit is none of #14's three transition sources).

inputs: garden-complex.spawn-tables.json (verified) + adjacent area tables per #11's route graph
visit window roll (seeded, reproducible — #94's discipline: same inputs, same guest)
derivation.output: a present guest for the window; when the window closes nothing persists

to_the_visitor: no bond, no care axes, no honours
no return-identity: a later window's guest is a new derivation — 'the same individual' is a question the system does not ask
to_the_world: #14 dex states untouched (no seen, no kept from a visit)
residents' records untouched by the visit itself

open_slots: which adjacent areas' tables join the Garden's (geography, at landing against #11)
visitor behaviour beyond #152's existing Garden view (profile-lane work)
festival-window coincidence (#105/#195 overlay question — not ruled here)
reactions: residents react per their #152 Garden-view profiles; visitor-resident sound is #155-class presentation (cries only — the voice law holds in the Garden)
residency: becoming a resident is the world's ordinary path (encounter -> keep -> #106 location) — the visitor system has no keep-the-guest verb, by construction

visitor_shape.individual: <a wild individual of the stocked species — transient, encounter-scoped>
visitor_shape.speciesId: <must be stocked by the Garden-complex tables or a joined adjacent table, in an active window (roster-binding, #84)>
